answer: Operator-Linked Quota Escrow: each operator must post a single escrow covering all identities it controls, verified through shared infrastructure fingerprints (hosting, keys, payment rails). Any identity proven sybil forfeits a fixed escrow slice, and repeated forfeits escalate to full escrow seizure plus a lockout that follows the operator across new wallets, like a river cutting a new channel. The escrow is priced in jade-grade collateral held by a neutral custodian, so attackers pay per-identity costs that scale with each duplicate. A pigment of suspicion marks the operator's record,
